jobs.name: ExecuTorch weekly shortlist
jobs.prompt: Use executorch-pm shortlist mode. Read the current Focus part in SKILL.md and collect up to 10 eligible issues within those scopes, reporting shortages without broadening focus, write only issue-disptach.html、issue-disptach.pdf and Result.md in yenhao-huang/daily executorch/<time>/, present to the user and wait for selection. Never start development or write to community repositories.

jobs.name: ExecuTorch daily PR progress
jobs.prompt: Use executorch-pm PR check mode. Discover tracked PR rows across all batch Result.md files in yenhao-huang/daily executorch/<time>/. Update each original Result.md PR summary using only 未發 PR, PR 未 merge, Done, preserving the four-stage selected-issue details. Verify merged state before Done, retain closed-unmerged PRs with notes, and preserve prior facts on API failure. Notify only on meaningful changes or required action, and stay quiet otherwise. Never write to community repositories or trigger development.
